parsed.notes:
Seniority is null because the posting hires at several levels at once ('Professional, Senior Professional und Principal'), which is treated like 'all levels'; flagged for review.
The headings 'Unternehmensbeschreibung' (company description) and 'Stellenbeschreibung' (responsibilities) are not ask sections. DevOps and Scrum appear only in the responsibilities and are not labeled. The coding-agent ask in the responsibilities is repeated under Qualifikationen and is labeled from there.
The 'Interesse daran, ... einzuarbeiten' bullet is appetite under rule 3. Everything it names is nice_to_have: Azure ML, Public Cloud, Data Factory/Synapse and ETL/ELT.
Azure is nice_to_have in both of its mentions: the Interesse bullet, and the Kenntnisse bullet marked 'sind von Vorteil' (= is an advantage).
Cloud is required through 'Erfahrung in der netzwerkseitigen Anbindung von Cloud-Umgebungen', an unmarked requirement; per the any-required-wins rule this overrides 'Public Cloud' in the Interesse bullet. Flagged because the mapping of cloud and networking is interpretive.
AI-assisted Coding and Vibe Engineering collapse into ai-developer-tooling, together with 'Coding Agents' (an alias).
'Azure Machine Learning' is read as an Azure product name, not as the machine-learning skill. It is covered by azure (nice_to_have).
'Debuggen von Docker-Images' is labeled docker only, not testing.
Degree: 'vergleichbare Qualifikation' (comparable qualification) is an alternative to the degree, so or_equivalent is true. No level is named, so the degree is bachelor.
